attacks.label: Bite

Web Sense: knows the location of any creature in contact with its webs.
Web (Recharge 5-6): DC 12 DEX save or restrained. Escape DC 12 STR.

attacks.label: Shortsword
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me creaks forward and stabs with a corroded shortsword! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the point punches clean between the ribs!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — brittle finger-bones lose their grip on the hilt!"; "thrusts!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing
No breath, no hesitation, no fear of the wound it's about to take. Whatever gave it its orders isn't in the room.

attacks.label: Shortbow
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me draws a warped shortbow with a dry rattle of finger-bones! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the arrow finds the eye socket's twin!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the bowstring snaps against brittle bone!"; "looses an arrow!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing (80/320 ft.)
It doesn't blink, because it can't. It just keeps drawing.

Skeleton.notes: CR 1/4. Vulnerable to bludgeoning. Immune to poison.

attacks.label: Slam
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me lurches forward and slams with a rotting fist! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — bone cracks under the blow!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the swing overbalances the rotten frame entirely!"; "slams!"]
ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] bludgeoning
Slow. Relentless. It does not register the wounds you give it — not until something asks its body to actually stop.

attacks.label: Undead Fortitude (0 HP save)
attacks.note: DC 5 + damage taken CON save (Zombie CON 16, +3) to drop to 1 HP instead of 0. Fails automatically against radiant damage or a critical hit.

[h: dmg = input("dmg|Damage that reduced the Zombie to 0 HP|0|NUMBER")][h: save=1d20+3][h: dc=5+dmg]/me refuses to fall — UNDEAD FORTITUDE!
CON save: [e: save] vs DC [e: dc] (5 + damage taken) — [r, if(save>=dc): "SUCCEEDS — drops to 1 HP instead of 0. It is still standing."; "FAILS — the body finally stops moving."]
Does not trigger against radiant damage or a critical hit — the corpse falls the normal way in either case.

traits: Undead Fortitude: when reduced to 0 HP, DC 5+damage CON save to drop to 1 HP instead.
Zombie.notes: CR 1/4. Undead Fortitude. Slow (20 ft. speed).

[h: atk1=1d20][h: dmg1=2d6][h: atk2=1d20][h: dmg2=2d4][h: save=1d20]/me lunges in with rot-black claws and needle teeth!
Bite: [r, if(atk1==20): "CRITICAL"; if(atk1==1): "FUMBLE"; "hits"] — ATK [e: atk1+2] | DMG [e: dmg1+2] piercing

Multiattack: one Bite and one Claws, every turn it can reach a target.

traits: Multiattack: one Bite and one Claws per turn.
Ghoul.notes: CR 1. Paralysing claws (DC 10 CON). Elves immune to paralysis.

attacks.label: Multiattack (Bite + Claws)

attacks.raw_cmd:

Bite: [r, if(atk1==20): "CRITICAL"; if(atk1==1): "FUMBLE"; "hits"] — ATK [e: atk1+5] | DMG [e: dmg1+3] piercing
Claws: [r, if(atk2==20): "CRITICAL"; if(atk2==1): "FUMBLE"; "hits"] — ATK [e: atk2+5] | DMG [e: dmg2+3] slashing

TURNING DEFIANCE: while within 30 ft. of a ghoul, this Ghast has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

traits: Multiattack: one Bite and one Claws per turn.
Stench: creatures within 5 ft. must DC 10 CON save or poisoned until start of next turn.
Ghast.notes: CR 2. Stench aura. Paralysing claws (DC 10 CON).

Shadow.immunities: Cold, necrotic, poison; frightened, exhaustion, grappled, paralysed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
Shadow.resistances: Acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from non-magical weapons

attacks.label: Strength Drain
attacks.note: Target's STR score reduced by the damage dealt. If STR reaches 0, target dies. Reduction lasts until short/long rest.

ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] necrotic

traits: Amorphous: can move through any gap at least 1 inch wide.
Shadow Stealth: can Hide as a bonus action in dim light or darkness.
Sunlight Weakness: disadvantage on attacks, checks, and saves in sunlight.
Create Shadow: a humanoid slain by this shadow's Strength Drain rises as a new shadow in 1d4 hours.
Shadow.notes: CR 1/2. Strength Drain — kills at STR 0. Sunlight weakness.

attacks.label: Create Specter

[r: "CREATE SPECTER — the Wraith targets a humanoid killed within the last minute that it can see within 10 ft. That corpse rises immediately as a Specter under the Wraith's control. Maximum 7 specters at once."]

ATK: [e: atk+4] (spell attack) | DMG: [e: dmg] necrotic

attacks.label: Longbow
attacks.raw_cmd:

ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing (150/600 ft.)
Multiattack: two attacks per turn, chosen from Longsword or Longbow — but one of those two attacks can be replaced with Life Drain instead.

ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] necrotic

attacks.label: Consume Life (Bonus Action)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: save=1d20]/me hovers over the dying victim — CONSUME LIFE! Target at 0 HP within 5 ft must make CON save: [e: save] vs DC 10 — [r, if(save>=10): "survives — stable at 0 HP."; "DIES INSTANTLY. The will-o-wisp regains 10 (3d6) HP."]
Bonus action only. Target must be at 0 HP and still alive. Wisp can use Invisibility (bonus action) to vanish after feeding.

traits: Consume Life: if creature within 5 ft. drops to 0 HP, regains 10d8 HP (bonus action).
Ephemeral: cannot wear or carry anything.

Invisible (bonus action): until attacks or uses Consume Life.
Will-o-Wisp.notes: CR 2. AC 19. Consume Life on nearby deaths. Can go invisible.

attacks.label: Club (with Shillelagh)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d8]/me swings a gnarled oak branch with druidic force — SHILLELAGH! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — bark and bone crack together!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the branch snags on roots!"; "strikes!"]
ATK: [e: atk+6] | DMG: [e: dmg+4] bludgeoning (magical)
Requires Shillelagh spell active (1/day). Without it: +2 to hit, 1d4 bludgeoning. Magic Resistance: advantage on saves vs spells. Tree Stride: step into large tree, emerge from another within 60 ft (10 ft of movement).

attacks.label: Fey Charm
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: save=1d20]/me fixes the target with ancient, verdant eyes — FEY CHARM! Target (humanoid or beast within 30 ft) WIS save: [e: save] vs DC 14 — [r, if(save>=14): "resists — unsettled but free."; "CHARMED for 24 hours. The target regards the Dryad as a trusted friend. The Dryad can have 1 humanoid + 3 beasts charmed at once. Charm ends if the Dryad or its allies harm the target."]
No attack roll — saving throw only. Innate spells: entangle, goodberry (3/day each); barkskin, pass without trace (1/day each).

traits: Innate Spellcasting (CHA DC 14): Druidcraft (at will), Entangle (3/day), Goodberry (3/day), Shillelagh (3/day), Barkskin (1/day), Pass Without Trace (1/day), Shapechange (1/day), Speak With Plants (1/day).
Tree Stride: once per turn, can enter a tree and exit another tree within 60 ft.
Dryad.notes: CR 1. Fey Charm (DC 14 WIS). Spellcasting CHA. Tree Stride.

attacks.label: Greataxe

ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing

[h: r1=1d20][h: r2=1d20][h: best=if(r1>=r2,r1,r2)][h: dmg=1d12]/me abandons all defense and swings with RECKLESS fury! (rolled [e: r1] and [e: r2] — uses [e: best]) [r, if(best==20): "CRITICAL HIT — a berserk, bone-shattering blow!"; if(r1==1 && r2==1): "DOUBLE FUMBLE — overcommits completely!"; "attacks!"]
ATK: [e: best+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing
RECKLESS ATTACK: this attack has advantage. In exchange, all attacks against the berserker have advantage until the start of its next turn. Below half HP, it uses this every round without exception.

traits: Reckless Attack: can give all attacks this turn advantage, but attacks against it also have advantage until start of next turn.

attacks.label: Spear

ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] piercing (one-handed) — two-handed: [e: (1d8)+1] piercing
Just a soldier doing the job. No malice in it, no glory either — hold the line, keep the watch, go home at the end of the shift.

Alone: [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "hits"] — ATK [e: atk+3] | DMG [e: dmg+1] bludgeoning
With an ally within 5 ft. of the target — PACK TACTICS (advantage): rolled [e: pt1] / [e: pt2], uses [e: ptbest] — [r, if(ptbest==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(ptbest==1): "FUMBLE!"; "hits"] — ATK [e: ptbest+3] | DMG [e: dmg+1] bludgeoning

traits: Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks when an ally is adjacent to target.

ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing
Multiattack: two Shortsword attacks OR one Shortsword + one Longbow. Keen Hearing and Sight: advantage on Perception. Natural Explorer: difficult terrain in forests doesn't slow movement.

attacks.label: Longbow
attacks.raw_cmd:

ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing (range 150/600 ft.)

traits: Multiattack: two Shortsword or two Longbow attacks per turn.
Keen Hearing and Sight: advantage on Perception checks.
Dark Devotion: advantage on saves vs. charmed and frightened.

attacks.label: Multiattack (Dagger x2)
attacks.note: Two dagger attacks per turn.

traits: Dark Devotion: advantage on saves vs. charmed and frightened.

attacks.label: Gladius
attacks.raw_cmd:

ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing

attacks.label: Pilum
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me hurls the weighted javelin with legionary precision! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the pilum pierces shield and flesh!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the shaft bends on impact, useless!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] piercing (range 30/120 ft.)

traits: Multiattack: two Gladius attacks or two Pilum attacks per turn.
Shield Wall: while adjacent to an ally with a shield, AC +1 and Dex saves +1 (included in stat block).

attacks.label: Gladius
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me steps in behind the shield and drives the gladius short and low! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — textbook legionary form, straight to the gap!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the thrust goes wide, shield discipline slips!"; "stabs!"]
ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] slashing
Standard drill: short blade, tight formation, no wasted motion. This is what the testudo is built to protect.

attacks.label: Pilum
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d4]/me hurls a pilum in a practiced overhand arc! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — punches through shield and shoulder alike!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the throw sails wide of the mark!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] piercing (30/120 ft.)

attacks.label: Slam
attacks.raw_cmd:

ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] bludgeoning

attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: recharge=1d6][h: dmg=3d8][h: save=1d20]/me rears back and a freezing grey mist billows outward in a 20 ft. cone! Recharge: [e: recharge] — [r, if(recharge>=5): "AVAILABLE this turn."; "NOT RECHARGED — only a thin cold vapour escapes, no effect."]
If available: target CON save [e: save] vs DC 12 — [r, if(save>=12): "succeeds — half damage."; "fails — full damage, and if living, ages 1d4 years."] Damage: [e: dmg] necrotic (half on a success).
Recharges on a roll of 5 or 6 at the start of its turn — reroll the recharge check every round.

traits: Mound Bound: can only leave its burial mound at night; forced back at sunrise.
Treasure Sense: knows the location of valuables buried within 1 mile.
Haugbui.notes: CR 2 (custom). Mound-bound. Grave Mist ages targets. Returns to mound at sunrise.

attacks.label: Nightmare Crush
attacks.note: DC 13 WIS save or target falls into nightmare sleep. Paralysed, takes 2d6 psychic damage at start of each turn. Awakens if takes damage or ally spends action to rouse them.

traits: Shapechanger: can polymorph into a small animal or back. Stats unchanged.
Nightmare Entry: while target is sleeping, can enter dreams. Nightmare Crush used without breaking stealth.
Sunlight Sensitivity: disadvantage on attack rolls in direct sunlight.
Alp.notes: CR 2 (custom). Germanic nightmare spirit. Nightmare Crush paralysis. Shapechanger. Sunlight weakness.

attacks.label: Water Lure
attacks.note: DC 14 WIS save or charmed and compelled toward the nearest body of water. Repeats save when harmed.

traits: Amphibious: breathes air and water.
Shapechanger: can take humanoid form (usually alluring youth). Stats unchanged.
Water Lure: lures victims toward water where they risk drowning.
Iron Weakness: takes 2d6 extra damage from cold iron weapons.
Nix.notes: CR 2 (custom). Norse water spirit. Lures victims to drown. Shapechanger. Cold iron weakness.

attacks.label: Bone Chill Touch
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d8][h: save=1d20]/me surges forward with frost-burned hands! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the chill sinks to the marrow!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — fingers pass through harmlessly!"; "claws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg] cold
Target CON save: [e: save] vs DC 11 — [r, if(save>=11): "resists the cold — no additional effect."; "SLOWED — speed reduced by 10 ft until end of its next turn."]

attacks.label: Wail of the Lost (Recharge 5-6)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: recharge=1d6]/me opens its hollow mouth in a keening shriek! Recharge roll: [e: recharge] — [r, if(recharge>=5): "WAIL ACTIVATES — all creatures within 30 ft make WIS save DC 12 or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage and are FRIGHTENED until end of their next turn. Half damage on success, no Frightened."; "Wail not ready yet (rolled "+recharge+"/6)."]
Area: 30 ft radius. The Myling shrieks the name it never received. Creatures who fail feel an irrational guilt.

traits: Incorporeal: can move through creatures and objects.
Tragic Compulsion: compelled to find its place of birth or death; will not leave the area.
Myling.notes: CR 1/2 (custom). Nordic child ghost. Wail causes fear. Cannot leave its haunting ground.

attacks.label: Spirit Touch
attacks.note: DC 11 WIS save or frightened until end of next turn.
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6][h: save=1d20]/me reaches through the air with a hand of cold mist — SPIRIT TOUCH! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the cold goes straight to the bone!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the grasping hand passes through empty air!"; "touches!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg] necrotic
Target WIS save: [e: save] vs DC 11 — [r, if(save>=11): "holds steady."; "FRIGHTENED until the end of its next turn."]
THRESHOLD GUARDIAN: if the target is crossing a threshold this Vaettir guards — a doorway, a bridge, a boundary stone — this attack is made with advantage.

attacks.label: Land Bond (on defeat)
attacks.note: If the Vaettir dies here, it reforms in 1d4 days unless the land is consecrated.
attacks.raw_cmd:
/me dissolves into mist and sinks back into the ground it is bound to.
LAND BOND: this Vaettir is bound to a specific location. If it dies here, it reforms in 1d4 days unless the land is consecrated. GM: mark the location — this is not necessarily the last time.

traits: Threshold Guardian: attacks with advantage on any creature that crosses a threshold (doorway, bridge, boundary) it guards.
Land Bond: bound to a specific location. If it dies here, reforms in 1d4 days unless the land is consecrated.
Vaettir.notes: CR 1/4 (custom). Norse nature spirit turned malevolent. Guards thresholds. Reforms unless land consecrated.

attacks.label: Bite
attacks.note: Target must DC 11 CON save or contract Larvae Pestilence (disadvantage on CON saves for 24 hrs).

traits: Swarm Frenzy: when 3+ larvae are within 5 ft. of a target, their attacks deal +1d4 necrotic damage.
Roman Lore: larvae are the restless dead who died violently or without proper burial rites. Appeasement rituals (DC 13 Religion) drive them off.
Larvae.notes: CR 0 (custom). Roman restless dead. Diseasing bite. Rituals drive them off.

attacks.label: Psychic Presence
attacks.note: DC 14 WIS save for half. On fail: target also has disadvantage on INT, WIS, CHA checks until end of next turn.

attacks.label: Binding Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
attacks.note: One creature must DC 15 WIS save or be paralysed for 1 minute. Repeats save at end of each turn.

traits: Incorporeal (fixed): cannot be moved or grappled; occupies its bonded location.
Sense Intentions: knows the intention (hostile/neutral/friendly) of any creature within 30 ft.
Propitiation: a DC 13 Religion check with an offering (wine, blood, grain) ends hostility and grants a blessing (+1d4 to one ability check within 24 hrs).
Genius_Loci.notes: CR 3 (custom). Roman place spirit. Paralysing gaze. Propitiation ritual ends hostility.

attacks.label: Blood Drain
attacks.note: Target's max HP reduced by damage dealt until they complete a long rest.

attacks.label: Screech (Recharge 5-6)
attacks.note: DC 12 CON save or stunned until end of next turn. All creatures within range (including allies).

traits: Keen Hearing and Smell: advantage on Perception checks using those senses.
Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is adjacent to target.
Roman Omen: Romans treat this creature as a dire omen (DC 13 Religion to recognise).
Strix.notes: CR 1/4 (custom). Roman blood-drinking owl spirit. Blood Drain reduces max HP. Screech stuns.

traits: Reckless Attack: can give all attacks this turn advantage, but attacks against it also have advantage.
Germanic Fighter: proficient with framea, seax, and francisca.
Grunwald_(Foederatus).notes: CR 2. Allied Germanic warrior. Reckless Attack. Treats Romans as cautious allies.

attacks.label: Sacred Flame
attacks.note: DC 14 DEX save for half. No cover benefit.

attacks.label: Guiding Bolt
attacks.note: Next attack roll vs. this target has advantage.

traits: Spellcasting (WIS DC 13, +5 to hit): Thaumaturgy (at will), Guidance (at will), Sacred Flame (at will), Bless (2/day), Healing Word (2/day), Guiding Bolt (2/day), Spirit Guardians (1/day).
War Priest (3/day): after attacking, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
Flavius_Martis_(Flamen_Martialis).notes: CR 2. Priest of Mars. Spellcasting WIS. Spirit Guardians, Bless, healing.

traits: Information Network: has advantage on Insight checks to detect lies; once per day can 'know' a rumour about any NPC in the fort or vicus.
Tavern Keeper: friendly NPCs within 10 ft. have advantage on Persuasion checks when Brennus is present.
Brennus.notes: CR 1. Germanic tavern keeper. Information network. Friendly but self-interested.

traits: Supply Master: can requisition or deny any mundane item within the camp (no roll required, but may demand favours).
Ledger Memory: advantage on all checks related to prices, inventories, and supply records.
Quartus.notes: CR 1. Quartermaster. Controls camp supplies. Favours economy.

attacks.label: Tongs (Grapple)
attacks.note: Target is also grappled (escape DC 14).

traits: Master Smith: can repair any mundane weapon or armour given 1 hour and raw materials.
Arena Past: once per turn, when hit by a melee attack, can halve the damage (reaction).
Rufus_the_Smith.notes: CR 2. Former gladiator, now smith. Powerful melee. Halve damage reaction.

attacks.label: Sacred Flame
attacks.note: DC 12 DEX save for half.

traits: Spellcasting (WIS DC 12): Sacred Flame (at will), Guidance (at will), Healing Word (2/day).
Augur's Eye: advantage on Religion checks related to Roman omens and divination.
Paterculus.notes: CR 1/4. Augur's assistant. Minor spellcasting. Omen expertise.

traits: Cunning Action: can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
Evasion: when making a DEX save for half damage, takes no damage on success and half on failure.
Imperial Intelligence: can send coded messages to Rome once per week.
Aemilia_Secunda_(Frumentarius).notes: CR 1. Frumentarius agent. Cunning Action. Evasion. Imperial spy network.

traits: Watchword Authority: can issue the day's watchword; any soldier who hears it must make DC 12 WIS save or feel compelled to answer truthfully about their duties.
NCO Discipline: allies within 10 ft. have advantage on saves vs. frightened.
Marcus_Sextius_(Tesserarius).notes: CR 1. Watch NCO. Issues watchwords. Rally vs. fear.

attacks.label: Standard Strike (Reach)
attacks.note: Uses the signum (standard) as a weapon.

traits: Rally the Legion (1/day): all friendly creatures within 30 ft. gain advantage on their next attack roll.
Pay Master: controls soldiers' wages; can withhold or grant pay as leverage.
Lucius_Calvus_(Signifer).notes: CR 1. Standard-bearer. Rally ability 1/day. Controls pay.

traits: Armory Access: can issue or refuse weapons and armour from the armory (one per session as leverage).
Equipment Expert: advantage on checks to identify, repair, or evaluate weapons/armour.
Publius_Arma_(Custos_Armorum).notes: CR 1/2. Weapons master. Controls armory access.

traits: Scribe's Memory: can recall any document he has read with perfect accuracy.
Records Keeper: access to all fort payrolls, letters, and supply manifests. Forging his seal is DC 18.
Quintus_Caelius_(Librarius).notes: CR 1/8. Fort scribe. Perfect recall. Controls official records.

attacks.label: Field Bandage (action)
attacks.note: Stabilise a dying creature or restore 1d6+3 HP to a creature at 0 HP. Uses medical supplies.

traits: Combat Medic: stabilising a dying creature is a bonus action (not an action).
Herb Lore: can identify and apply herbs for natural cures. Advantage on Medicine and Nature checks in Roman frontier terrain.
Titus_Vindex_(Capsarius).notes: CR 1/2. Field medic. Bonus action stabilise. Herb expertise.

traits: This token represents the vacant Aquilifer role. Metellus, the former bearer, is dead.
The Aquila (eagle standard) is missing — whoever finds and returns it gains 2 commendationes.
Any PC who assumes this role gains: Inspiring Presence (allies within 30 ft. +1 to attack rolls while standard is visible).
Aquilifer_(Vacant_Metellus_Dead).notes: VACANT. Metellus died in Session 1. The Aquila is missing. Reclaiming it is a campaign objective.

attacks.label: Divine Pilum (×4 Multiattack)
attacks.note: Four attacks per round. Victory condition: reduce to 150 HP or force concession.

attacks.label: Legendary Strike
attacks.note: Legendary Action (end of another's turn). 3/round.

traits: Legendary Resistance 3/day: auto-succeed on failed save.
War Cry (recharge 5-6, 30 ft): DC 18 WIS save or Frightened 1 min.
Divine Smite 1/round: one hit per round deals extra 4d8 radiant.
Legendary Actions (3/round): Strike, God's Eye (2 actions: all attacks vs one target have adv), Summon Fallen (3 actions: Skeleton appears).

attacks.label: Hand Crossbow
attacks.note: Sneak Attack 4d6 on first hit per turn when has advantage or ally within 5 ft. of target.

traits: Multiattack: 2 Longsword attacks or 1 Hand Crossbow + 1 Longsword.
Assassinate: advantage on attacks vs creatures that haven't acted yet. Hits on surprised creatures are automatic crits.

attacks.label: Dagger (thrown)
attacks.note: Sneak Attack 4d6 on first hit per turn when has advantage or ally within 5 ft. of target.

traits: Multiattack: 2 Shortsword attacks.
Assassinate: advantage on attacks vs creatures that haven't acted. Hits on surprised creatures are automatic crits.
Uncanny Dodge: reaction to halve one attack's damage.

attacks.label: Sacred Flame (spell)
attacks.note: No attack roll. Target makes DC 13 DEX save or takes 3d8 radiant damage.

traits: Spellcaster DC 13 (WIS). Cantrips: Guidance, Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying.
Spells: Healing Word, Inflict Wounds, Hold Person, Speak with Dead, Divination.
Multiattack: 2 Gladius attacks, or 1 Pilum + 1 Gladius.
Parry: reaction to add +3 to AC against one melee hit.

attacks.label: Greataxe
attacks.note: Reckless Attack: advantage on first attack roll each turn (attackers gain adv vs him until his next turn).

traits: Multiattack: 2 attacks.
Reckless Attack: grants advantage on first greataxe attack; attackers gain advantage vs him until next turn.
Dying Defiance: when reduced to 0 HP, makes one final attack as a reaction.
Völva: can cast Guidance (cantrip), Speak with Animals, and Augury (1/day).
Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as bonus action.

attacks.label: Dagger
attacks.note: Poisoned blade: DC 13 CON save or 2d6 poison damage and Poisoned 1 hour.

traits: Master of Intrigue: Mastermind subclass. Help as bonus action (30 ft range).
Rarely fights directly — prefers to use Tribune Lucius or hired killers.
Observer for Germanic tribes. Non-combatant who prefers flight.
Tribal warrior and firekeeper. Protects sacred flame sites.
Multiattack: 2 attacks.
Spear-Mother: allies within 10 ft. gain +1 to attack rolls.
Trader with Germanic connections. Non-combatant; fights only in self-defense.
Germanic healer. Spells: Healing Word (2/day), Spare the Dying.
Scout. Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as bonus action.

attacks.label: Fire Bolt (spell)
attacks.note: Ranged spell attack.

traits: Mage. Spellcasting DC 13 (INT). Prefers Medicine and magical healing in combat.
Spy. Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as bonus action.
Imperial courier; knows every road, garrison, and shortcut between Vindolanda and Eboracum.

attacks.label: Fog Cloud (Druid A — Round 1)
attacks.raw_cmd:
/me begins the fog-chant — mist rises from the earth around the wall!
Fog Cloud: 20ft radius sphere, 120ft range, Concentration.
All creatures inside: HEAVILY OBSCURED = BLIND (attacks have disadvantage, attackers have advantage vs them).
No save. Wall defenders cannot aim ranged weapons down into fog. CON save DC 10+ damage taken each hit to maintain concentration. Kill this druid = fog ends immediately.

attacks.label: Entangle (Druid B — Round 1)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: saveroll=1d20]/me slams her staff into the earth — roots and vines erupt!
Entangle: 20ft square, 90ft range, Concentration. STR save DC 12.
Target rolled STR: [e: saveroll] vs DC 12 — [r, if(saveroll>=12): "SAVES — difficult terrain only"; "RESTRAINED — speed 0, repeat save each turn"]
Restrained on a ladder = FALLS (1d6 per 10ft). Difficult terrain even on save. Kill this druid = entangle ends.

attacks.label: Spike Growth (Phase 2 — Conc)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: dmg1=1d4][h: dmg2=1d4]/me twists the ground — invisible razor spikes erupt across the approach!
Spike Growth: 20ft radius, 150ft range, Concentration.
Moving through: [r: dmg1+dmg2] piercing per 5ft (2d4, this roll). Looks like natural terrain — Perception DC 15 to spot.
A defender sprinting 30ft through it: [e: (dmg1+dmg2)*6] piercing. Cast in courtyard or gate approach. Kill druid = spikes vanish.

attacks.label: Hold Person (use on best melee fighter)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: saveroll=1d20]/me points and chants a binding curse!
Hold Person: WIS save DC 12. 2nd level, 60ft range, Concentration.
Target rolled WIS: [e: saveroll] vs DC 12 — [r, if(saveroll>=12): "SAVES — no effect"; "PARALYZED — all attacks are AUTO-CRITS until they save"]
Repeat save each turn. While paralyzed: berserkers walk up and auto-crit with greataxes. Priority target: party's best melee fighter. Kill druid = paralysis ends.

attacks.label: Produce Flame (cantrip 30ft)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d8]/me hurls a ball of flame! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL BURN!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — flame sputters out!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+4] fire
Visible as floating flame in the druid's hand — unmistakable kill target for archers. While conscious: all Germanic raiders +1 ATK and advantage vs fear. Kill either druid = chanting buff ends for all raiders.

attacks.label: Thunderwave (emergency melee only)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: d1=1d8][h: d2=1d8][h: saveroll=1d20]/me SLAMS the staff and unleashes a thunderclap!
Thunderwave: 15ft cube, CON save DC 12.
Target rolled CON: [e: saveroll] vs DC 12 — [r, if(saveroll>=12): "half dmg: [e: (d1+d2)/2] thunder, no push"; "FULL: [e: d1+d2] thunder + pushed 10ft + knocked prone"]
Audible 300ft. LAST RESORT — only if melee closes. Immediately flees into treeline after casting. Below 10 HP: unit morale drops visibly when chanting stops.

Druid.notes: CR 2. Two druids. Kill priority — chanting buff ends when they die.

attacks.label: GATE — Battering Ram (automatic)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: d1=1d6][h: d2=1d6][h: d3=1d6][h: total=d1+d2+d3+4]/me SLAMS into the gate! Gate takes [r: total] bludgeoning ([r: d1]+[r: d2]+[r: d3]+4 | 3d6+4)
Gate HP: 60. Mark cumulative damage — breaches in ~3 rounds. Arrow slits: 3/4 cover (AC 15, +5 Dex saves to target him from wall). INT 5: cannot be tricked or lured. He is pointed at the gate. Gate. Gate. Gate.

attacks.label: Greatclub (if engaged)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: d1=1d8][h: d2=1d8]/me swings the greatclub at whoever got in the way! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL SMASH!"; if(atk==1): "MISS — club hits gate instead (gate takes [e: 1d6+4])!"; "attacks!"]
ATK: [e: atk+6] | DMG: [e: d1+d2+4] bludgeoning (2d8+4)
Large creature — threatens all squares within 5ft. Shove as bonus action vs Medium creatures (STR contest, ogre +4).

attacks.label: Javelin (30/120 ft — if ranged)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: d1=1d6][h: d2=1d6]/me hurls a javelin at anyone blocking the gate approach! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — javelin clatters off stone!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+6] | DMG: [e: d1+d2+4] piercing (2d6+4)
Carries 3. Uses javelins only when he cannot reach the gate — someone is physically blocking his path. He will try to shove past first.

Ogre.notes: CR 2. Living battering ram. East postern flanking = disadvantage on his attacks.

attacks.label: Bite (+ Knock Prone)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: d1=1d6][h: d2=1d6][h: proneroll=1d20]/me LUNGES with snapping jaws! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL — jaw locks on!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — slips on rubble!"; "bites!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: d1+d2+3] piercing (2d6+3)
Target STR save: [e: proneroll] vs DC 13 — [r, if(proneroll>=13): "holds footing"; "KNOCKED PRONE — prone = adv on all attacks vs target"]
Worg INT 7 — understands Norse, sometimes speaks. Speed 50ft — chases fleeing soldiers. Large: blocks doorways and ladders. Used by the warband as scouts and terror weapons.

Worg.notes: CR 1/2. Knock prone on bite DC 13 STR. Speed 50ft.

attacks.label: Shortbow
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me looses an arrow from the boulders (zone 9)! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — arrow skips off stone!"; "fires!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing
Half cover: attackers need AC 13. Pack Tactics: advantage if ally within 5ft of target. Retreats immediately if anyone closes to melee.

attacks.label: Seax (melee — last resort)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d4]/me draws his seax in desperation! [r, if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "slashes!"]
ATK: [e: atk+2] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] piercing
Archer is fleeing — this attack means he is cornered. He will break and run next turn if alive.

attacks.label: Morale Check (GM — use when below 6 HP or ally drops nearby)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: wis=1d20]/me loses nerve! Morale WIS check: [e: wis] vs DC 10 — [r, if(wis >= 10): "HOLDS — stays in position this round."; "BREAKS — drops bow, flees treeline at full speed. Does not return unless druids still chanting."]
Trigger: below 6 HP, or 2+ allies dropped within 30ft this round, or druid killed (chanting buff ends).

Germanic_Archer.notes: CR 1/4. Zone 9 suppression. Pack Tactics. Morale breaks when below 6 HP or druids die.

attacks.label: Framea — Thrown (before ladder)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me hurls his framea at the wall defenders before charging! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — spear buries in mud!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing (30/120 ft)
Pack Tactics: advantage if ally within 5ft. After throwing, he charges the ladder — no more ranged attacks.

attacks.label: Framea — Melee (at the parapet)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg1h=1d6][h: dmg2h=1d8]/me thrusts the framea at the parapet defender! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "stabs!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg1h+2] piercing (one-hand) or [e: dmg2h+2] two-handed if shield dropped
Pack Tactics: adv if ally within 5ft — devastating once 2+ reach the wall. On ladder he had no shield (+1 AC) — once on wall he reseats it next round.

attacks.label: Seax — Backup Blade
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d4]/me draws the seax! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; "slashes!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing (light weapon)
Light — can dual wield with framea as bonus action attack.

attacks.label: Morale Check (GM — use when below 8 HP or 3+ allies fall in 30ft)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: wis=1d20]/me falters! Morale WIS check: [e: wis] vs DC 10 — [r, if(wis >= 10): "HOLDS — grits teeth, keeps fighting."; "BREAKS — shoves ally aside, leaps off ladder or sprints for treeline. Pack Tactics lost (no ally within 5ft of his target)."]
Trigger: below 8 HP, or 3+ spearmen/archers fell this round within 30ft, or gate is breached (panic spreads). Druid chanting (while alive): this check is at DC 8 instead of DC 10.

Germanic_Spearman.notes: CR 1/2. Ladder assault. Morale check below 8 HP or mass casualties.

attacks.label: Francisca — Thrown (Round 1)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6][h: bounce=1d20]/me HURLS the francisca before mounting the ladder! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — axe buries in armour!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — axe skips wide!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing
Bounce check — target rolls Acrobatics: [e: bounce] vs DC 12 or loses shield bonus until bonus action to reseat it.
Used ONCE in Round 1 before ladder. Danger Sense: advantage on Dex saves vs visible effects (ballista, oil).

attacks.label: Greataxe — Normal
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d12]/me swings the greataxe! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — bone-splitting blow!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "attacks!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing
Choose RECKLESS button instead for advantage — but attackers get advantage back on him.

attacks.label: Greataxe — RECKLESS (adv both ways)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: r1=1d20][h: r2=1d20][h: best=if(r1>=r2,r1,r2)][h: dmg=1d12]/me RECKLESSLY attacks! (rolled [r: r1] and [r: r2] — uses [r: best]) [r, if(best==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(r1==1 && r2==1): "DOUBLE FUMBLE!"; "charges in!"]
ATK: [e: best+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing
ALL attacks vs this berserker have ADVANTAGE until his next turn. He does not care. Below half HP he uses this every single round.

Germanic_Berserker.notes: CR 2. Vercingetorix's champion. Francisca R1, then reckless greataxe.

attacks.label: Shortbow — Fire + NIMBLE ESCAPE (bonus action)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me pops up from cover and fires! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — arrow through the eyeslot!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — bowstring snaps mid-draw!"; "looses!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing (80/320 ft)
NIMBLE ESCAPE (bonus action): Immediately Hides (Stealth +6) or Disengages after firing. Zero opportunity attacks. Sprints to new cover before next round. Never in same position twice.
If the goblin was hidden this turn, this attack was at ADVANTAGE — use the ADV button instead.

attacks.label: Shortbow — ADVANTAGE (fired from concealment this turn)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: r1=1d20][h: r2=1d20][h: best=if(r1>=r2,r1,r2)][h: dmg=1d6]/me fires from concealment! (rolled [r: r1] / [r: r2] — uses [r: best]) [r, if(best==20): "CRITICAL HIT — perfect concealed shot!"; if(r1==1 && r2==1): "DOUBLE FUMBLE — both shots go wide!"; "looses from the dark!"]
ATK: [e: best+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] piercing
Concealment attack — target couldn't pinpoint the shooter. NIMBLE ESCAPE after: goblin must reach new cover before next round. Stealth +6 vs passive Perception to stay hidden.

attacks.label: Scimitar — LAST RESORT (goblin is cornered)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me draws a rusted scimitar in desperation! [r, if(atk==20): "CRIT — lucky slash!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — drops the blade and shrieks!"; "slashes wildly!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] slashing
Goblins NEVER willingly fight in melee. Being in melee means it is cornered or terrified. It will Disengage and flee next turn — automatically. No morale check.

attacks.label: Morale — AUTO-FLEE (4 HP or below, or allies routed)
attacks.raw_cmd:
/me turns and RUNS for the treeline at full speed!
No morale check required. Goblins auto-flee at 4 HP or below, or when 3+ nearby goblins are killed in the same round. They drop bows and don't come back. Druid chanting (while alive) delays this by 1 round only.

Goblin_Skirmisher.notes: CR 1/4. Nimble Escape every round — immune to OA. Stealth +6. Auto-flee at 4 HP. Best as 8-12 skirmishers. Never in same spot twice.

attacks.label: Spear — Standard
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d8]/me advances in disciplined formation and thrusts! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — perfect thrust to the gap!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — overextended!"; "thrusts!"]
ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] piercing
TACTIC: Hobgoblins WAIT to attack until a second reaches the parapet. Two on the wall = Martial Advantage triggers. They will sacrifice their first turn to hold position.

attacks.label: Spear + MARTIAL ADVANTAGE (ally within 5ft of TARGET)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d8][h: ma1=1d6][h: ma2=1d6]/me strikes in perfect coordination with an ally! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — disciplined killing blow!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "attacks in formation!"]
ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] + MARTIAL ADVANTAGE +[e: ma1+ma2] ([r: ma1]+[r: ma2]) piercing
Triggered when ANY ally is within 5ft of the TARGET — not the hobgoblin. Two hobgoblins attacking the same defender: BOTH get Martial Advantage. Average total damage 13+ per hit from a CR 1/2 creature.

attacks.label: Longsword two-hand (on wall, shield dropped for reach)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d10]/me drops the shield and swings two-handed from the parapet! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — sweeping slash!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "swings!"]
ATK: [e: atk+3] | DMG: [e: dmg+1] slashing (two-hand — shield dropped, AC now 16)
Used once firmly established on the parapet. Reaches over allies. Will re-equip shield as bonus action next round (AC back to 18). STILL benefits from Martial Advantage on this attack.

Hobgoblin_Warrior.notes: CR 1/2. AC 18 is the point — hard to hit, dies in 2-3 hits. Martial Advantage makes them spike dangerous. Always position 2+ at same target. Formation fighters, not berserkers.

attacks.label: Greataxe (after AGGRESSIVE bonus action move)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d12]/me CHARGES in using AGGRESSIVE (bonus action: +30ft) and swings! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — bone-splitting charge!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — overextended the charge!"; "attacks!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing
AGGRESSIVE: This orc moved up to 30ft as a bonus action this turn — total 60ft possible. Cannot be kited by slow characters. Closed the gap in ONE turn and attacked.
TACTIC: Orcs always use Aggressive. If the target is on the wall, they will climb a ladder and Aggressive along the parapet toward the nearest defender.

attacks.label: Javelin — throw before closing (carries 3)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me hurls a javelin before using AGGRESSIVE to close! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — javelin punches through armour!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — javelin falls short!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] piercing (30/120 ft)
Throw first, then AGGRESSIVE bonus action to close. Carries 3. Not a ranged combatant — this is the opening. Once out of javelins, pure melee.

attacks.label: RELENTLESS ENDURANCE — when dropped to 0 HP (once per combat)
attacks.raw_cmd:
/me drops to one knee... then ROARS and surges back up. RELENTLESS ENDURANCE!
RELENTLESS ENDURANCE: Orc would drop to 0 HP — drops to 1 HP instead. Once per combat. GM: mark used.
NOW BERSERK: The orc knows it is dying. Until it takes further damage, it attacks with absolute ferocity — gains Advantage on its next attack roll (primal rage response to near-death). Then any further hit drops it to 0.

Orc_Raider.notes: CR 1/2. Aggressive = closes 60ft per turn, impossible to kite. Relentless Endurance = survives one killing blow. Frontliners, not tacticians. Rush, hit, survive, repeat.

attacks.label: Morningstar — BRUTE (2d8 on every hit, 10ft reach)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: d1=1d8][h: d2=1d8]/me swings the heavy morningstar with brutal force! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — bone-crushing impact!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — missed badly, overbalanced!"; "smashes!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: d1+d2+2] piercing (BRUTE: 2d8+2 every hit)
LONG-LIMBED: Melee reach is 10 ft — can hit parapet defenders from below if adjacent to wall. This creature is 7 feet tall with unnaturally long arms.
TACTIC: Bugbears ambush from the drainage ditch on the east side. They appear mid-combat from an unexpected direction. Primary goal: GRAPPLE defenders off the wall, not kill them on it.

attacks.label: Morningstar + SURPRISE ATTACK (target hasn't acted this combat or is surprised)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: d1=1d8][h: d2=1d8][h: s1=1d6][h: s2=1d6]/me erupts from hiding — SURPRISE ATTACK! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — devastating ambush strike!"; "smashes before target can react!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: d1+d2+s1+s2+2] piercing
(BRUTE 2d8+2 + SURPRISE +2d6 = avg 21 damage on first hit)
SURPRISE ATTACK only on the FIRST hit when target hasn't taken a turn yet this combat. This is why bugbears hide until the perfect moment — they are assassins. 21 average damage on a CR 1 creature is terrifying.

attacks.label: GRAPPLE attempt (bonus action when morningstar hit connects)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: bg_str=1d20]/me grabs the defender after the hit — GRAPPLE attempt!
Bugbear STR check: [e: bg_str+4]
GRAPPLE: Target must make STR (Athletics) or DEX (Acrobatics) vs [e: bg_str+4]. On failure: target is GRAPPLED (speed 0).
PULL OFF WALL: Bugbear uses remaining movement to drag grappled target 10ft. If target was on a wall/ladder: falls to ground (1d6 bludgeoning, PRONE). This removes one defender from the wall entirely — they must spend a turn standing and climbing back up.
Primary tactic: not killing ON the wall, but removing defenders FROM it. One successful grapple-and-drag = one combat turn wasted by a PC.

Bugbear_Ambusher.notes: CR 1. Surprise Attack opener (21 avg damage). Brute on all hits. Long-limbed 10ft reach. Grapple pull = removes defenders from wall. Appears mid-combat from east drainage ditch.

attacks.label: Composite Longbow — Precision (ignore cover, 150/600ft)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d8]/me draws and looses in one smooth motion! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — perfect shot through the gap!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "fires!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] piercing (150/600 ft range)
PRECISION SHOT: Syrian composite bow training allows ignoring half and three-quarter cover on ranged attacks within 150ft. The druids behind their boulders (normally 3/4 cover AC+5) take NO cover bonus against this archer.
Auxiliary archers from Syria/Judea. Exceptional range and accuracy. Assign to neutralize zone 9 druids and the ogre's eyes.

attacks.label: Rapid Fire — two shots (both at -2 to hit)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk1=1d20][h: atk2=1d20][h: dmg1=1d8][h: dmg2=1d8]/me looses two arrows in rapid succession!
Arrow 1: ATK [e: atk1+3] | DMG [e: dmg1+3] piercing
Arrow 2: ATK [e: atk2+3] | DMG [e: dmg2+3] piercing
Rapid Fire: fires twice as action, -2 to hit on both. Best used against the ogre (large target, -2 to hit barely matters) or to apply pressure on multiple enemies.

Syrian_Archer.notes: CR 1. Roman Syrian auxiliary. Composite bow — ignores half/3-quarter cover, 600ft range. Assign to druid suppression and ogre. 2-4 present at most forts. Racial diversity: typically Semitic/Arab stock in D&D terms.

attacks.label: Slam
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=3d8][h: modDmg=dmg+6]/me slams with divine weight! [r, if(atk+10>=20): "SLAM HITS AC "+(atk+10)+" — "+modDmg+" bludgeoning"; "MISSES (rolled "+(atk+10)+")"]
Multiattack: 2 Slam attacks per turn. Immutable Form: immune to polymorph. Magic Resistance: advantage on spell saves.

attacks.label: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: recharge=1d6][h: dc17=1d20]/me channels divine stillness — SLOW! [r, if(recharge>=5): "SLOW ACTIVATES — all creatures within 10 ft. make DC 17 CON save or speed halved, no reactions, only one attack per Attack action."; "Slow not ready (rolled "+recharge+"/6)"]
On failed save: lasts 1 min (CON save each turn to end). Does NOT fade when ritual completes — GM removes golems manually.

traits: Immutable Form: immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
Magic Resistance: advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.
Multiattack: two Slam attacks per turn.
GM NOTE: these are Mars-avatars, NOT combat wins. Goal = hold them 4 rounds while ritual completes.
Stone_Golem.notes: CR 10. Sacred Grove Sessions 3-4. Avatars of Mars manifesting through standing stones. Fade when ritual completes.

attacks.label: Slam
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me animates with terrible purpose — SLAM! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the gauntlet crushes bone!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the armour lurches wide!"; "strikes!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] | DMG: [e: dmg+2] bludgeoning
Multiattack: two Slam attacks per turn. Antimagic Susceptibility: incapacitated inside an antimagic field. False Appearance: indistinguishable from ordinary armour while still.

attacks.label: Greatsword
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=2d6]/me swings the greatsword in a two-handed arc! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the blade cleaves deep!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the stroke goes wide!"; "attacks!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] slashing
Multiattack: two Greatsword attacks per turn. Brave: advantage on saves vs Frightened. Parry (Reaction): +2 AC against one melee attack the Knight can see.

attacks.label: Heavy Crossbow
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d10]/me levels the crossbow and fires! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the bolt punches through!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the bolt skips off stone!"; "fires!"]
ATK: [e: atk+2] | DMG: [e: dmg] piercing (range 100/400 ft.)
Used at range. Only one crossbow attack (no Multiattack with ranged). Parry reaction still available.

attacks.label: Leadership (Recharge: Short/Long Rest)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[r: "LEADERSHIP ACTIVE — for the next minute, one ally within 30 ft who can hear and understand the Knight may add 1d4 to an attack roll or saving throw once per turn (before the roll). The Knight must not be incapacitated."]
Declare at start of the Knight's turn. Lasts 1 minute (10 rounds). Recharges after short or long rest.

attacks.label: Spear of Mars
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: base=1d8][h: fire=1d6]/me drives the burning spear forward with divine fury! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the spear blazes white with Mars's wrath!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the divine flame sputters!"; "thrusts!"]
ATK: [e: atk+9] | DMG: [e: base+5] piercing + [e: fire] radiant (divine)
Multiattack: three attacks per turn. One attack may be substituted for a Net throw. Two-handed versatile: 1d8+5.

attacks.label: Shield Bash
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=2d6][h: save=1d20]/me crashes the iron shield into the target! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the bash sends them sprawling!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "slams!"]
ATK: [e: atk+9] | DMG: [e: dmg+5] bludgeoning
Target STR save: [e: save] vs DC 16 — [r, if(save>=16): "holds footing"; "KNOCKED PRONE"]
Counts as one of her three Multiattack strikes.

attacks.label: Net
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20]/me hurls the weighted net! [r, if(atk==20): "PERFECT THROW — the net wraps tight!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — net tangles wide!"; "throws!"]
ATK: [e: atk+6] (range 5/10 ft.) — on hit: RESTRAINED (Large or smaller). DC 10 STR check (action) to break free. Speed 0 while restrained.
Replaces one of her three Multiattack strikes. Net has AC 10, 5 HP, immunity to bludgeoning + poison + psychic.

attacks.label: Legendary Defiance (1/round when below 50 HP)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[r: "LEGENDARY DEFIANCE — Fausta's first drop below 50 HP triggers this automatically (1/combat). She gains 20 temporary HP and auto-succeeds on one saving throw this round."]
Frozen Advance: difficult terrain does not slow her. Mars calls Enough after 10 rounds or when she reaches 0 HP a second time.

attacks.label: Ash Form (at 0 HP)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[r: "FAUSTA COLLAPSES — her body crumbles to hot grey ash. Mars may spend a Legendary Action to reform her at 20 HP (once per combat). If Mars does not act, she is defeated and the trial ends."]
She does not make death saving throws. The ash is not a creature and cannot be targeted. If Mars reforms her, place the token at the arena center at 20 HP.

Banshee.resistances: Acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from nonmagical attacks
Banshee.immunities: Cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

attacks.label: Corrupting Touch
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=3d6]/me reaches out with a hand of freezing grief — CORRUPTING TOUCH! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the cold passes straight through the heart!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — her hand passes through empty air!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg] necrotic
Incorporeal Movement: passes through walls/objects (5 force damage if ending turn inside). Resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; nonmagical weapons. Immune: cold, necrotic, poison.

attacks.label: Horrifying Visage
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: save=1d20]/me turns her true, ruined face toward the room — HORRIFYING VISAGE! Each living creature within 60 ft that can see her: WIS save [e: save] vs DC 13 — [r, if(save>=13): "resists — immune to this banshee's Horrifying Visage for 24 hours."; "FRIGHTENED for 1 minute (repeat save each turn). If the save failed by 5+, also ages 1d4×10 years, right now, visibly."]
Does not affect undead. Free action, no attack roll.

attacks.label: Wail (1/day)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: save=1d20][h: dmg=10d8]/me opens her mouth and every grief she ever carried comes out at once — WAIL! Every living creature within 30 ft that can hear it: CON save [e: save] vs DC 13 — [r, if(save>=13): "resists — takes half damage only."; "TAKES FULL DAMAGE. If this reduces the target to 0 HP, it dies outright."]
DMG: [e, if(save>=13): floor(dmg/2); dmg] psychic
Once per day. Does not affect constructs or undead. This is the banshee's single scariest moment — use it when the fight needs a spike, not on round 1.

traits: Detect Life: can magically sense the presence of living creatures up to 5 miles away; knows their general direction but not exact location.
Incorporeal Movement: can move through creatures and objects (takes 5 force damage if ends turn inside).

attacks.label: Bite
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=4d6]/me strikes with a skeletal, fang-bare jaw — BITE! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — bone locks through bone!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the jaw snaps shut on nothing!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg+3] piercing

attacks.label: Hold Person (spell)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: save=1d20]/me hisses a word that isn't breath — HOLD PERSON! One humanoid it can see within 60 ft: WIS save [e: save] vs DC 12 — [r, if(save>=12): "resists."; "PARALYZED for the spell's duration. Target may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns."]
Spellcasting (8th level, DC 12, +4 to hit): at will — mage hand, minor illusion. 1/day each — hold person, ray of enfeeblement, detect thoughts, suggestion, dispel magic.

attacks.label: Ray of Enfeeblement (spell)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=2d8]/me traces a withering ray from an eye socket — RAY OF ENFEEBLEMENT! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT."; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the ray goes wide."; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+4] (spell attack) | DMG: [e: dmg] necrotic, and while the spell lasts the target's Strength-based weapon attacks deal only half damage.
Save-ends-early: target or an ally can spend an action to attempt to end it (no save needed on the naga's part).

traits: Rejuvenation: if destroyed, a bone naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all HP, reforming near its old bones, unless the remains are sprinkled with holy water or a Remove Curse / Dispel Evil and Good is cast on them first.

Yochlol.resistances: Cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from nonmagical weapons

attacks.label: Poisonous Tentacle
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=2d6][h: save=1d20]/me lashes out with a tentacle that shouldn't exist on anything shaped like a person — POISONOUS TENTACLE! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — it wraps twice before the target can react!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — the tentacle misjudges the reach!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] reach 15 ft | DMG: [e: dmg+2] poison, and target is grappled (escape DC 14).
While grappled, target repeats CON save [e: save] vs DC 15 each of its turns — [r, if(save>=15): "resists further poison this turn."; "takes 2d6 poison again."]

attacks.label: Innate Spellcasting
attacks.raw_cmd:
[r: "INNATE SPELLCASTING (CHA, DC 14) — at will: charm person, dancing lights, minor illusion. 3/day: fog cloud. 1/day: insect plague."]
Use insect plague to control the battlefield in the blood-growth rooms — it thematically doubles as the fleshy growths swarming.

attacks.label: Change Shape
attacks.raw_cmd:
[r: "CHANGE SHAPE — the yochlol polymorphs into a Large or smaller spider, or back into its true ooze-and-limbs form, as an action. Stats are the same except speed (spider form gains climb 30 ft)."]
No attack roll. Use to escape a bad position or to ambush from a ceiling/wall in spider form.

traits: Magic Resistance: advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Shapechanger: true form is neither wholly humanoid nor wholly ooze — unsettling to look at even at rest.

Shadow_Demon.resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, thunder; acid, bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from nonmagical weapons
Shadow_Demon.immunities: Necrotic, poison; grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

attacks.label: Claw
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=3d6]/me tears free of the dark between the pillars — CLAW! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the claw passes through flesh like it isn't there!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — it overreaches into the light and flinches back!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+5] | DMG: [e: dmg] necrotic, and the target's hit point maximum is reduced by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. Target dies if this reduces its maximum to 0.
Incorporeal Movement. Immune: necrotic, poison. Resistant to nonmagical weapons.

attacks.label: Shadow Stealth (bonus action)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[r: "SHADOW STEALTH — while in dim light or darkness, the shadow demon takes the Hide action as a bonus action."]
It will keep breaking line of sight and re-hiding between the altar's pillars every round it can — do not let it stand still and trade blows.

traits: Illumination Weakness: disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in bright light.
Sunlight Weakness: takes damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saves while in direct sunlight (not relevant underground, but matters if the fight is dragged outside).

attacks.label: Bite
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d6]/me snaps forward, more hunger than plan — BITE! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE — it bites itself as much as anything!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+2] | DMG: [e: dmg] piercing

attacks.label: Claws
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=1d4]/me scrabbles with both filth-crusted hands — CLAWS! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+2] | DMG: [e: dmg] slashing

attacks.label: Fetid Cloud (recharge 6)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: save=1d20]/me releases a cloud of noxious gas — FETID CLOUD! Each creature within 10 ft: CON save [e: save] vs DC 11 — [r, if(save>=11): "resists."; "POISONED for 1 minute (repeat save at end of each turn)."]
Use to punish the party for clumping up — dretches are weak alone but a swarm with this recharging is genuinely nasty.

traits: Chaff, not a threat alone: dretches exist to fill rooms and force the party to split attention while the real threat (a stronger demon or the room's undead) does the actual damage.

attacks.label: Pincer (part of Multiattack)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=2d10]/me lunges with a massive crab-like claw — PINCER! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT — the pincer closes with a sound like a door slamming!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+9] reach 10 ft | DMG: [e: dmg+5] bludgeoning, and if the target is Medium or smaller it is grappled (escape DC 15). The glabrezu has two pincers and can grapple two different creatures at once.

attacks.label: Fist (part of Multiattack, only vs. a creature grappled by a pincer)
attacks.raw_cmd:
[h: atk=1d20][h: dmg=2d4]/me drives a fist into whatever its pincer is already holding — FIST! [r, if(atk==20): "CRITICAL HIT!"; if(atk==1): "FUMBLE!"; "connects!"]
ATK: [e: atk+9] reach 5 ft | DMG: [e: dmg+3] bludgeoning
Multiattack: two pincers, then two fists (only against targets already grappled by a pincer) -- or it forgoes some/all of its attacks to cast a spell instead.

attacks.label: Innate Spellcasting
attacks.raw_cmd:
[r: "INNATE SPELLCASTING (CHA, DC 16) — at will: darkness, dispel magic, detect magic. 1/day each: confusion, fly (self only), power word stun."]
Open the fight with Darkness centered on whatever it is guarding, then Power Word Stun on whoever gets closest. Magic Resistance: advantage on saves vs spells/magical effects.

traits: Magic Resistance: advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Truesight 120 ft: sees through darkness, illusions, and shapechanged forms without being fooled.
